metadata.title: Reproducibility materials for Probabilistic Coverage Optimization for Underwater Sensor Networks under Three-Dimensional Localization Uncertainty
metadata.description: Executable source, formula-to-code registry, pseudocode, complete parameters, frozen synthetic computational results, real Copernicus Marine GLORYS12V1 historical current subsets, current-conditioned replay outputs, raw Monte Carlo observations and reproduction instructions. Environmental input is the official public OceanBench one-degree derivative, not native-resolution data or sensor field measurements. Training year 2018 is separated from held-out year 2019. The frozen-current displacement rule and residual Gaussian position model are explicitly assumed. External ocean data retain their provider terms; the MIT license covers original Python source. Confidential review reports are excluded.
